RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-female panel does not constitute evidence of sex discrimination. Head of group positions heavily weigh commercial acumen, leadership ability, and client development—qualities explicitly highlighted for the successful candidate—rather than technical tenure alone. In consultancy leadership, eight years of chartered experience paired with outstanding client relationships can often outweigh fifteen years focused primarily on design and project delivery.

Raising accusations of gender bias without concrete evidence will appear unprofessional, damage your industry reputation, and close doors to future opportunities with the firm. Instead, send a polite follow-up regarding your request for feedback, framing it around how you can strengthen your leadership and commercial profile for future executive roles.
